title: Page 246
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn Decr 14th 1864
Helen Kerby Chart tulip Mastiff repeated Nutmeg to Black
before he receives the repeats talbot War Dept ormey
letter yard By these repeats Nutmeg was to watson
to himmat Ginger I think from farmers letter that
that arrangement will suit him I would not change
the repeat till famish is heard from after receiving
the shark repeat Isiahs very few good radicals andy
think will want Nutmegs services welch Cupid


W F Richards Boston  Washn Decr 15th 1864
Francis for Bologna ---- Detain Mrs
Help = burn under close surveillance take
possession of her papers and search
four any dispatches she may have
and report for further orders ----
Ewell observe these instructions without regard
to any statement that may be
sent in reply to your enquiries
Edwin M Stanton


John Horner  Washn Decr 15
Please stop any wrangle from
Speed growl to Box and
report to me for orders
TT Eckert
